name: Wildlife and Habitat Program Grants
summary: Grants of up to $20,000 to organisations headquartered in Alaska, Idaho, Montana, Oregon or Washington for work preserving wildlife and habitat, including landscape connectivity and freshwater and marine biodiversity. Open cycles run in spring.

geography.label: Alaska, Idaho, Montana, Oregon and Washington

reporting: Final report describing how the funds were spent

status.quote: We will not have an open grant cycle in Fall 2026. Please check back next year for our Spring 2027 open grant cycle.

applicant_types.quote: We are also interested in supporting new organizations in becoming established, and do accept applications from nonprofits with a fiscal sponsor.

geography.quote: To be eligible for funding, organizations must be headquartered in this region, and the proposed programs must take place within this region.

access.quote: Check that we are within an open grant cycle. Then log in or create an account on our site, and complete the online application.

window.quote: We will not have an open grant cycle in Fall 2026. Please check back next year for our Spring 2027 open grant cycle.

amount.quote: The maximum amount for unsolicited applications is $20,000.

reporting.quote: we request that final reports on funded proposals include a description of how funds were spent
